connect.lazerBuild: Build the independent lazer test client
connect.title: Your next session starts here.
connect.subtitle: Choose your client. Follow the requirements. Keep your official account separate.
connect.accountText: Use the username and password you registered here. Your official osu! account remains separate.
connect.stableText: Use stable's -devserver option with your operator's configured domain. The domain must route the bancho, assets and web endpoints to this deployment.
connect.toolText: Preview the hosts changes first. Kaleidoscope manages its own marked block, keeps a byte-for-byte backup, and can restore it. Applying changes to system hosts requires administrator privileges.
connect.tlsText: HTTPS must validate for the actual hostname. A hosts entry changes routing only; it does not make a certificate trusted.
connect.lazerTitle: lazer requires a compatible client build
connect.lazerText: The stock client's production endpoints and OAuth configuration are fixed. Kaleidoscope exports endpoint settings for a source build. API v2, OAuth and SignalR support must all be completed before full play is available.
connect.compatibilityText: Protocol tests verify parsing and API behaviour. Complete stable/lazer play, multiplayer and replay submission still require real client testing. Do not switch your main client until your operator confirms support.
connect.restoreText: Close osu!, restore Kaleidoscope's managed hosts block, and remove the stable -devserver argument. Launch your normal client again.
